result.instructions: Tools for Medplum, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Find the patient Jane Doe born in 1980 and list her active conditions."; "Show the latest vital signs for patient 0f3c… (blood pressure, heart rate)."; "Which medication requests are active for this patient?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Medplum data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run medplum_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run medplum_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run medplum_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. medplum_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: medplum_search_patients
tools.title: Search patients
tools.description: Search Patient resources by name, identifier or birth date. Use this first to find a patient id. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/Patient.

identifier.description: Identifier value, e.g. a medical record number.

tools.name: medplum_get_patient
tools.title: Get a patient
tools.description: Read one Patient by id. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/Patient/{id}.

tools.name: medplum_search_encounters
tools.title: Search encounters
tools.description: List Encounter resources (visits or admissions) for one patient. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/Encounter?patient=Patient/{id}.

tools.name: medplum_search_observations
tools.title: Search observations
tools.description: List Observation resources (lab results, vital signs) for one patient. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/Observation?patient=Patient/{id}.

tools.name: medplum_search_conditions
tools.title: Search conditions
tools.description: List Condition resources (diagnoses, problems) for one patient. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/Condition?patient=Patient/{id}.

code.description: Condition code, e.g. a SNOMED CT code.

tools.name: medplum_search_allergies
tools.title: Search allergies
tools.description: List AllergyIntolerance resources for one patient. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/AllergyIntolerance?patient=Patient/{id}.

tools.name: medplum_search_medication_requests
tools.title: Search medication requests
tools.description: List MedicationRequest resources (prescriptions) for one patient. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/MedicationRequest?patient=Patient/{id}.

tools.name: medplum_search_appointments
tools.title: Search appointments
tools.description: List Appointment resources for one patient, or for one practitioner's schedule. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/Appointment.

patient_id.description: Only appointments for this Patient id.

practitioner_id.description: Only appointments with this Practitioner id.

tools.name: medplum_search_practitioners
tools.title: Search practitioners
tools.description: Search Practitioner resources (clinicians) by name or identifier. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/Practitioner.

tools.name: medplum_get_resource
tools.title: Get a resource
tools.description: Read one resource by type and id. Allowed types: Patient, Encounter, Observation, Condition, AllergyIntolerance, MedicationRequest, Appointment, Practitioner, Organization, Location. FHIR R4: GET /fhir/R4/{ResourceType}/{id}.
